meta.title: WorkBuddy autostart
meta.description: Starts WorkBuddy2API Hub (127.0.0.1:7863) with DSH by default, with wb2api available as an alternative; starts silently and can optionally manage the workbuddy model list in the profile.

en.autoUpdateDrifted: The backend executable was replaced by hand; automatic updates will not overwrite it.
en.autoUpdateError: The last automatic update check failed: {reason}
en.autoUpdateFailed: The automatic update to {tag} did not succeed ({reason}); the previous version is still in use. This version will not be installed automatically again; click "Update" to install it by hand.
en.autoUpdateHint: Stable releases older than {hours} hours are downloaded in the background and installed the next time DSH starts; if the new version fails to start, the previous one is restored.
en.autoUpdateLast: Automatically updated from {from} to {to} at {time}; click "Roll back" if something is wrong.
en.autoUpdatePending: {tag} is downloaded and will be installed the next time DSH starts.
en.autoUpdateRolledBack: You rolled back from {tag}; automatic updates skip it and wait for the next release.
en.autoUpdateUnavailable: The backend executable is set in your config (or version management is off), so the plugin does not manage its version and automatic updates do not apply.
en.autoUpdateUnknown: The current backend version cannot be identified, so automatic updates do not apply; you can still click "Update".
en.autoUpdateWaiting: Upstream {tag} is less than {hours} hours old; it will be downloaded after {time}.
en.backendNoAccounts: The backend is running but has no usable WorkBuddy account yet; sign in from the backend panel above.
en.backendPurged: Cleared {root}. You can now uninstall this plugin on the Plugins page.
en.backendPurgeHint: Uninstalling this plugin in DSH does not delete {root}; click "Fully uninstall" first to remove it.
en.balanceHint: Reads cached HUB balances without chat requests or upstream refreshes.
en.balanceOverview: {realm} remaining credits: {balance}; {enabled} enabled accounts, {known} with balance data
en.description: Tick the models that should appear in the DSH model list; the multiplier comes from the backend /v1/models.
en.disabledHint: Model sync is off; saving only updates the selection. Enable “Sync to the DSH model list” and save to generate the list.
en.emptyHint: Selecting nothing means “sync every backend model” (the existing meaning of an empty allow-list).
en.gatewayCredentialFailed: Gateway credentials could not be saved. Check the DSH credentials service and retry.
en.gatewayHubHint: The hub serves one exit at a time (China or international), following the exit switch at the top of the hub dashboard. CN and GL selections are saved separately (shared with wb2api's cn: / global: ids); after you switch the exit in the dashboard, the DSH model list changes to that set within seconds.
en.gatewayNoAccounts: The gateway switched, but its account pool is empty. Add a usable account before syncing models.
en.gatewayNotInstalled: Switched to {name}, but it is not installed yet: click "Install" below.
en.gatewaySynced: Switched to {name}. Models, URL and credentials were saved and synchronized automatically.
en.gatewaySyncFailed: The gateway switched, but automatic synchronization did not finish: {reason}
en.gatewayTimeout: Switched to {name}, but it was not ready within {seconds} s; try "Retry" or "Refresh" in the model list later.
en.gatewayWaiting: Switching to {name}, waiting for it to start…
en.hubDualHint: Shows CN / GL models in one WorkBuddy group, routed by the selected model region independently of the HUB dashboard. Uses the gateway key; region keys are only needed when it is bound to a region (stored only in DSH credentials; blank keeps saved values).
en.hubInventoryFailed: Settings saved, but the model list could not be refreshed. Please retry later.
en.hubKeyKeep: Saved; leave blank to keep, or enter a replacement
en.hubKeyMissing: No separate key; using gateway key
en.hubKeysSaved: Keys saved. Inputs were cleared to avoid displaying secrets; saved keys remain in use.
en.hubRealm: Current hub exit: {realm}. You are choosing the {realm} set; after switching to the other exit, DSH uses that exit's own selection (all of its models if you never chose any).
en.hubSettingsSaved: Region settings saved. Blank inputs keep saved keys.
en.hubSyncFailed: Settings and keys saved, but model sync did not finish: {reason}
en.modelsNoAccounts: The hub has no usable account yet ({total} total, 0 usable), so its models cannot be used and are not listed. Sign in or import a WorkBuddy account in the backend panel above, then click "Retry".
en.modelsNotInstalled: The backend is not installed yet. Click "Install" under "Backend version" below; the model list refreshes once it is installed.
en.panelKeyCopied: Access key copied: open the panel and paste it into the “access key” prompt; the browser remembers it.
en.panelKeyManual: Could not write to the clipboard; select and copy it manually:
en.panelKeyNone: The backend has no access key set; the panel opens without one.
en.panelPasswordChanged: The hub's panel password has been changed: the hub stores only its hash, so the plugin cannot read it. Sign in with the password you set.
en.panelPasswordCopied: Copied the hub's default panel password admin: paste it in the backend panel; consider changing it under Settings after signing in.
en.purgeDesc: Stops the backend and deletes the whole {root} directory: program, archived versions, config.json, credentials and state (data/), cache and logs.
en.purgeKept: This cannot be undone. To use it again you will need to reinstall the backend and sign in to your accounts again.
en.recoveryExternal: Paused: port belongs to another process
en.ruleHint: Rules and selections both apply, including to new models. Unknown prices are not treated as free. Bulk actions affect only filtered rows.
en.savedDisabled: Saved with sync off; the existing DSH model list is kept.
en.savedNoSync: Allow-list saved; the model list was not updated ({state}).
en.savedSync: Saved and regenerated the model list: {count} models.
en.summary: This plugin manages the WorkBuddy model list (selection + multiplier).
en.syncEnabled: Sync to the DSH model list
en.syncHint: When enabled, opening or refreshing this list syncs it to DSH; background sync runs every minute by default.
en.title: WorkBuddy models
en.uninstallDesc: Stops the backend and deletes its program files: wb2api.exe, archived versions, download cache.
en.uninstallHubDesc: Stops the hub and deletes its program directory (including the bundled Python runtime), archived versions and download cache.
en.uninstallHubKept: The hub's credentials, settings and usage (hub/data/) are kept.
en.uninstallKept: Credentials and state (data/) plus config.json are kept.
en.updateLinked: This plugin is installed from a local directory (file:), which dshmarket does not update. Pull the new code in the source directory and reinstall, or reinstall it from npm to update from here.
en.updateLost: The previous update task has finished or DSH restarted; the version shown here is current.
en.updateManaged: This plugin is managed by the DSH desktop app, so dshmarket will not update it. Uninstall it on the Plugins page and install the new version.
en.updateMismatch: Note: v{installed} was installed, not the expected v{target}.
en.updateNoMarket: Install the DSH plugin market (dshmarket) to update from here, or uninstall this plugin on the Plugins page and install the new version.
en.updateRefreshHint: Reload the page to apply it.
en.updateRolledBack: Update rolled back; the plugin stays at v{version}.
en.updateTooFresh: The new version is still inside pnpm's release cool-down. Try again later, or force the update.
